source_title: Schools to hold water, energy conservation activities before Diwali break - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Ahmedabad: In view of water scarcity concerns, rising electricity demand and limited natural resources, Ahmedabad district education officer (DEO) Rohit Chaudhari has directed all primary, secondary and higher secondary schools under the Ahmedabad city jurisdiction to organise awareness activities on water and energy conservation before Diwali vacation.According to the circular, schools must conduct special activities on the last working day before the vacation to encourage students to use natural resources responsibly. The initiative comes amid concerns over lower rainfall this year and the possibility of water shortages in the coming months.Students will be educated about saving electricity by switching off lights, fans, air conditioners and other electrical appliances when not required, and will be encouraged to make maximum use of natural light and ventilation. They will also be taught about alternative energy sources such as solar power.Water conservation will also be a focus area. Activities will underscore the importance of rational use of water, preventing leakage and understanding conservation methods like rainwater harvesting.At a special assembly on the last working day before the break, students will receive guidance on conserving water and energy. There will be a collective reading of a student pledge on rational use of water and electricity while adopting sustainable practices.The DEO has clarified that pressure, compulsory compliance or financial burden should not be imposed on students or parents for the initiative.
